mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.tag_name AS tagName, COALESCE(cnt.number, 0) AS number FROM tb_tag t LEFT JOIN ( SELECT atr.tag_id, COUNT(*) AS number FROM tb_article_tag_rel atr INNER JOIN tb_article a ON atr.article_id = a.id WHERE a.article_status = 1 GROUP BY atr.tag_id ) cnt ON t.id = cnt.tag_id ORDER BY t.sort DESC, t.id DESC;
